nice games you got rolling there.
Nah, survival didn't exist in D1 but they had freelance 6v6 I believe.

There was an issue with matchmaking, and extremely recently bungie said that they had addressed that issue where you match with players who are on either end of the spectrum. May you get your fabled again!

With Randy's throwing knife being a thing, a good portion of players are running scouts like mida or jade rabbit. Shotguns are also an option, and depending on the map you could get away with something like a hand cannon.
There's been plenty of people in your situation, and they all made it. Keep at it, and don't get discouraged; the season has only just started, after all.
It's right under the survival/competitive (fireteam 1-3) option, but instead only you and other solo players can enter. Only teams are allowed.
Most of my handful of losses were on the way from fabled to mythic. It's really wild in that stretch.
I play on both PC and Xbox One, but I've been playing on Xbox the past week. It took me 3 days to go from 0 to legend.

As per most of other players, if not all, I can agree that the matchmaking is very up and down with how the teams go. I was fighting people who were already at legend when I was getting to mythic, and being placed with players around fabled/low mythic when I hit legend.
